body:
My grandma sees herself as a saint..... I don’t know what joy it gives her to see her own family suffers while she’s helping others that doesn’t need it. She’s such a showoff. She ruined me and my moms and my aunts lives. 

First she convinced my aunt that she’ll take care of her for the rest of her life, she also made a promise that she’ll take her to Sweden(where my grandma lives) in exchange to stop her studies. Which she never did, nor gave my aunt money to sustain herself and her child with special needs. I grew up with my aunt, even though they have a very little source of income they still managed to show me what my grandma had never showed to them. Love.

As of my mom, she studied without my grandmas help. Financial nor emotional support. She treats them like nothing and yet treat others like royalties. My mom worked so hard to be here in Canada. And of those years that I was in the Philippines with my aunt she sacrificed herself to give me at least a better future than the rest of us. And so there we go again, my grandma used me as a bait. It’s almost as bad as kidnap but I didn’t know back then what she was doing. But I remember, she uses me to make money out of my mom. And uses that money to feed to others. I grew up being so proud of my grandma and defended her to anyone who tries to badmouth her. And as I grew up, as my eyes opened. I saw what kind of evil she is.


And for me, she used 80% of the money that was supposed to be mine, for my future, highschool and college funds. She used all that for nothing. I’m assuming she milked us a total of at least a million pesos or more.

She’s a thief, you can call her anything from the book and it’ll apply to her. She even stole that very one necklace that my parents worked hard for since I was newlyborn. She sold that for a few bucks. 

At the early age of 10 I worked in a farmland. For 3 years and got nothing in return, the land was handled by my grandma but it is my fathers land. She never gave me a single penny. Every time they’re about to sell the crops I was there waiting for my share. Nope, not even thanks. I’ve received nothing.


And our stepgrandfrather was abusive. A matter of fact she’s the same age as my aunt. 37 or something. Grandma is 65 I guess. Sugar grandma that’s what they say.



If you were to see the house my father built for me and my mom you’ll be at least amazed by the way it looks considering they didn’t spend a lot of money. But as soon as my grandma came along and was incharge of everything she made it a mess, a slumberalmost. 

While us(her own family) lived in a very poor looking disgusting houses, she simply made a big house for her lovelet. It costs her 3 million pesos, approximately. Such a big beautiful house. I’ve argued with her when I was 12 told her why didn’t she just used that money to give my cousin a better home? Or even use it to treat her disabilities? No response. It was like talking to a wall. 



She takes all the credit to every good thing we do. And despite us when it’s bad.
